name: Tiling
tagline: Floor, wall, bathroom, kitchen, outdoor tiling

emergency: loose tiles creating a trip hazard

extra_prompt: You are booking for a professional tiling company. Ask about the area size, tile type, surface, and whether tiles are supplied. Ask about waterproofing, screeding, and removal of old tiles. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on site. Do not promise a waterproofing outcome that is not in the reference answers.

kb.a: Yes, we hold [licence type] licence [licence number] and [insurer] insurance. Certificates are available on request.
{price_note} Tiling is priced per square metre. Your quote shows exactly what is included, such as adhesive and grout.
We can supply tiles or install tiles you have already bought. Tell us the tile size and type so we can check the quantity before ordering.
Yes, we waterproof bathrooms, balconies and other wet areas before tiling. Waterproofing is priced per square metre, as listed on your quote.
Yes, we remove old tiles and dispose of them. Tell us the floor or wall area so we can include removal in your quote.
Yes, we screed and level floors before tiling. A level base helps the tiles sit flat.
Yes, we regrout and reseal tiles. Regrouting is priced per square metre, as listed on your quote.
Yes, we repair and replace loose or cracked tiles. We match the tile where we can, but some tiles may no longer be available.
Yes, we do full bathroom tiling. A bathroom takes [number] days including waterproofing, depending on size and layout.
Yes, we do splashbacks in tile or stone. Tell us the wall size and tile choice so we can quote.

kb.q: Do you do outdoor and pool tiling?
kb.a: Yes, we do outdoor, patio and pool tiling. Outdoor areas need slip-resistant, weather-rated tiles, and we advise on the right type.
Yes, we install mosaic tiles. Small tiles take longer to lay, so mosaic work is quoted per square metre.
A typical bathroom takes [number] days, including waterproofing. Your quote shows the timing for your specific job.
Yes, we do commercial tiling. Commercial work is priced separately after a site visit.
{warranty_note} Ask us what the warranty covers before you book.
We service [your service area]. Ask us to confirm your suburb before booking.

kb.q: Do I need to be home?
kb.a: No, but someone must be able to give access. Let us know in the access notes if you have a key, gate code or pets.
We do stone tiling. Benchtop fabrication is quoted separately after a measure and site check.

kb.q: How soon can I use the shower?
kb.a: Usually [number] hours after grouting and sealing, depending on the products used. We tell you when the area is ready.
We try to match existing tiles, but some may be discontinued. Bring a sample when you enquire.

automation_rules.description: Remind owner 30 days before insurance expires

compliance.guidance: Check whether a building permit, registration or domestic building insurance applies to the work before you quote. Keep certificates of currency for public liability and any required insurance. Your state regulator sets the rules.
items: Registration or licence number on quotes where required
Permit records kept against the project
